name: Airdrie Media Posts for Bluesky
author: Jim Briggs

sections.description:
Airdrie Media Posts for Bluesky allows you to embed your Bluesky feed into your WordPress site via a shortcode. You can also create a Bluesky post from your WordPress posts (premium feature).

External Services

This plugin makes use of the Bluesky API to retrieve the requested Bluesky posts. It sends the specified Bluesky ID and App Password. The terms of service can be found at https://bsky.social/about/support/tos
sections.installation:
1) Have your Bluesky information ready. You will need to know your Bluesky user ID (the one that has the “@” symbol in it, not the display name) as well as your (free) Bluesky API key. To obtain an API key, log into your Bluesky account, go to “Settings” and then, under the “Advanced” heading, select “App passwords”.
2) Install and activate BlueskyFeed plug-in.
3) Under settings->BlueskyFeed, enter your user ID and API key. These are the only required entries on the settings field.
4) Create a WordPress page with a shortcode, eg: [bluesky-posts]
5) See www.airdriemedia.com/airdriemedia-posts-for-bluesky for more options.
